hero.title: A little escape.
hero.description: Step away from the everyday. Settle into a world of lush greens, warm conversations, and flavours worth lingering over.

about.title: In the heart of the city.
about.description: Up above Dhanmondi, a different kind of dining awaits. Forest Lounge brings a soft industrial setting, an open kitchen, and a love of coffee together in one inviting space.
about.detail: Come for a meal. Stay for the conversations, the atmosphere, and the simple pleasure of being together.

buffet.title: A world of flavours.
buffet.description: A little of your favourite. A taste of something new. Gather your people and make an occasion of the buffet experience at Forest Lounge.
buffet.note: Call us for the current buffet selection, prices, and availability.

menu.title: Follow your appetite.
menu.description: Take a closer look at the Forest Lounge à la carte menu. Your next favourite could be a page away.
menu.note: Menu and prices may change. Please confirm availability with our team.

events.title: Some moments deserve
events.description: Birthdays, family get-togethers, or an evening with your team. Tell us what you have in mind. We’ll help you plan a gathering that feels like you.

offersIntro.title: A reason to return.
offersIntro.description: Ask our team about current dining offers and group arrangements. A lovely meal is always worth making time for.

visit.title: There’s a place for you here.
visit.description: A table for two. A gathering of your favourites. Let’s make your next visit a little special.

contact.address: Imperial Amin Centre (rooftop), House 54, Road 10/A, Satmosjid Road, Dhanmondi, Dhaka, Bangladesh
